author: Jonathan Yantis
metric: PPS-relative input phase after own prior GNSS fixed base; not calibrated UTC accuracy
posthoc: Future fitted trend removal is descriptive precision only; never used as corrected forecast accuracy
reproduction_limit: Public analyzer recomputes phase-base subtraction and metrics from selected predictions and fixed prior phase bases, plus a posthoc future counter-rate diagnostic. Native frozen numeric bases were prospectively sealed; continuous bases use a locked prior-only rule and were computed offline. The analyzer does not recreate private software endpoints, physical bridge histories, prior phase-base measurements or full causal estimator replay.

primary_comparison.scope: System comparison of locked NTP-only WLS and nominated robust hybrid; coordinate and weighting differ, so this does not isolate the AP oscillator contribution.
primary_comparison.metric: Own fixed prior phase-corrected RMS, no future recentering or detrending; identical scored and prior-calibration PPS identities.

coordinate_diagnostic.scope: Posthoc future rate versus nominal1Hz PPS ordinal, identical AP-common witnesses; not steering or UTC calibration
